sents.t: Luca, I need you to punch his heart.
sents.zh: 卢卡，你得捶一下他的心脏

sents.t: That's right. The red thing. Punch it.
sents.zh: 没错，就是那个红色的东西。捶它

sents.t: Thanks for that. Too much oxygen up here.
sents.zh: 谢了。上面的氧气太多了

sents.t: Not like the deep. As you'll learn.
sents.zh: 不像深海。你以后就知道了

sents.t: Sure, there's no sunlight, but there's nothing to see anyway.
sents.zh: 当然，那里没有阳光，不过反正也没什么可看的

sents.t: Or do. It's just you and your thoughts, and all the whale carcass you can eat.
sents.zh: 也没什么可做的。就只有你和你的思绪，还有吃不完的鲸鱼尸体

sents.t: Little bits of it just float into your mouth.
sents.zh: 一小块一小块的，就飘进你嘴里

sents.t: You can't see it. So if you… The mouth opened, the whale carcass go in.
sents.zh: 你都看不见它。所以只要你……嘴一张开，鲸鱼尸体就进去了

sents.t: Come on. No time to waste.
You're going to stay with Uncle Ugo for the rest of the season.
sents.zh: 你要去乌戈舅舅那里住，一直住到这一季结束

sents.t: Two seasons, then. Wanna go for three?
The world is a very dangerous place, Luca.
sents.zh: 这个世界非常危险，卢卡

sents.t: And if I have to send you to the bottom of the ocean to keep you safe, so be it.
sents.zh: 如果我必须把你送到海底才能保证你的安全，那就这么办

sents.t: You don't know what it's like up there!
sents.zh: 你根本不知道上面是什么样的！

sents.t: I know you. And I know what's best for you.
sents.zh: 我了解你。我也知道什么对你最好

cards.ex: Oxygen is the gas in the air that we need to breathe. Uncle Ugo lives deep in the sea, so the air up here has too much oxygen for him.
exs: Fish get oxygen from the water.
cards.note: Day 10 原句：“Thanks for that. Too much oxygen up here.”（谢了。上面的氧气太多了）

cards.ex: A carcass is the dead body of an animal. A whale carcass is a dead whale. Deep in the sea, many animals eat it for food.
exs: Many sea animals can live on one whale carcass for years.
cards.note: Day 10 原句：“Or do. It's just you and your thoughts, and all the whale carcass you can eat.”（也没什么可做的。就只有你和你的思绪，还有吃不完的鲸鱼尸体）

cards.ex: Float means to move slowly on water or in the air, without sinking or falling.
exs: The leaf floated on the water.
cards.note: Day 10 原句：“Little bits of it just float into your mouth.”（一小块一小块的，就飘进你嘴里）

cards.ex: The rest of the season means all the time that is left in this season, until it ends.
exs: Our team will play without him for the rest of the season.
cards.note: Day 10 原句：“You're going to stay with Uncle Ugo for the rest of the season.”（你要去乌戈舅舅那里住，一直住到这一季结束）

cards.ex: So be it means “then that is how it will be.” You say it when you accept something, even if it is hard.
exs: If we have to walk home in the rain, so be it.
cards.note: Day 10 原句：“And if I have to send you to the bottom of the ocean to keep you safe, so be it.”（如果我必须把你送到海底才能保证你的安全，那就这么办）

exzh: 很多海洋动物能靠一具鲸鱼尸体生活好几年。

exzh: 如果我们得冒雨走回家，那就这样吧。

items.s: Thanks for that. Too much ___ up here.
items.why: Too much 后面接不可数名词。oxygen 是“氧气”，不加 s。
items.ft: Thanks for that. Too much oxygen up here.

items.s: Or do. It's just you and your thoughts, and all the ___ you can eat.
items.why: all the 后面接名词。whale carcass 在这里当不可数的“食物”来说，不加 s。
items.ft: Or do. It's just you and your thoughts, and all the whale carcass you can eat.

items.s: Little bits of it just ___ into your mouth.
items.why: 主语 Little bits 是复数，用动词原形 float。float 是“飘、漂浮”。
items.ft: Little bits of it just float into your mouth.

items.s: You're going to stay with Uncle Ugo for the ___.
items.why: for the rest of the season 表示“这一季剩下的时间里”。rest 用单数，season 也用单数。
items.ft: You're going to stay with Uncle Ugo for the rest of the season.

items.s: And if I have to send you to the bottom of the ocean to keep you safe, ___.
items.why: so be it 是固定说法，表示“那就这样吧”。be 用原形。
items.ft: And if I have to send you to the bottom of the ocean to keep you safe, so be it.
